title: Formal smoothness of a local quotient detected by its residue conormal differential
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $C$ a commutative $R$-algebra, $S$ a local commutative $R$-algebra with unique maximal ideal $\mathfrak n$, and $p:C\twoheadrightarrow S$ a surjective $R$-algebra homomorphism with finitely generated kernel $J$. Assume $C$ is formally smooth over $R$ (the $0$-adic case of [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]) and $\Omega_{C/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is a finite free $C$-module, meaning it is isomorphic to $C^{\oplus e}$ for some finite $e\ge0$. Put $k=S/\mathfrak n$, $M=J/J^2$, $T=S\otimes_C\Omega_{C/R}$ [def-weil-module-base-change], and let $\delta:M\to T$ be the $S$-linear conormal differential $j\bmod J^2\mapsto1\otimes\mathrm dj$. Then $S$ is formally smooth over $R$ (for the $0$-adic topology) if and only if $1_k\otimes\delta:k\otimes_SM\to k\otimes_ST$ is injective.
